headline: ACC reports a 92 percent drop in net profit to ₹93 crore for the quarter
hook: Sharp margin compression hits cement major
summary: Adani Group-backed cement maker ACC posted a steep 92 percent decline in net profit to ₹93 crore for the quarter, compared to ₹1,208.62 crore in the corresponding period last year, weighed down by higher operational costs and lower sales. Revenue from operations fell 5 percent year-on-year to ₹5,666 crore from ₹5,969 crore. Higher input costs and competitive pricing pressures eroded profitability across the cement segment. Indian retail investors tracking cement sector stocks should note the margin contraction amid aggressive capacity expansions by industry leaders.
whats_next: Upcoming quarterly earnings from peer cement manufacturers
why_it_matters: Cement sector margins face severe pressure from rising costs.
winners_losers: ACC shareholders hurt / low-cost cement producers gain
